01

“who perfected everything which He created”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 32:7).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
who perfected everything which He created [al-Sajda 7] he said: "He says: He made everything He created well made."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
الَّذِي أَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهُ [السجدة: 7] قَالَ: " يَقُولُ: أَتْقَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهُ
Edition record 373076 · p. 544Link to report ↗
02

“from a liquid disdained”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 32:8).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
from a liquid disdained [al-Sajda 8] he said: "meaning weak, which is the sperm of the man."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
مِنْ مَاءٍ مَهِينٍ [السجدة: 8] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي ضَعِيفًا وَهُوَ نُطْفَةُ الرَّجُلِ»
Edition record 373077 · p. 544Link to report ↗
03

“When we are lost within the earth”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 32:10).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
When we are lost within the earth [al-Sajda 10] He says: "when we are bones and crumbled remains, lost in the earth"; will we indeed be in a new creation? [al-Sajda 10].
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
أَئِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِي الْأَرْضِ [السجدة: 10] ، يَقُولُ: «أَئِذَا كُنَّا عِظَامًا وَرُفَاتًا هَلَكْنَا فِي الْأَرْضِ» ، أَئِنَّا لَفِي خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ [السجدة: 10]
Edition record 373078 · p. 544Link to report ↗
04

“The angel of death who has been entrusted with you will take you”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 32:11).

04
Explanation from Mujāhid 04

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
The angel of death who has been entrusted with you will take you [al-Sajda 11] he said: "The earth has been gathered for him and made for him like a basin, from which he takes wherever he wishes."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ مَلَكُ الْمَوْتِ [السجدة: 11] قَالَ: «حُوِيَتْ لَهُ الْأَرْضُ فَجُعِلَتْ لَهُ مِثْلَ الطَّسْتِ، يَنَالُ مِنْهَا حَيْثُ يَشَاءُ»
Edition record 373079 · p. 544Link to report ↗
05

“Their sides part from their beds”

Two explanations transmitted from Muʿādh ibn Jabal and Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 32:16).

05
Explanation from Muʿādh ibn Jabal 05

Muʿādh ibn Jabal

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama related to us, from Asim ibn Abi al-Najud, from Shahr ibn Hawshab, from Muadh ibn Jabal, who said:
The Messenger of God ﷺ recited this verse: Their sides part from their beds [al-Sajda 16], and he said: "It is the servant's rising at night."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ أَبِي النَّجُودِ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ، قَالَ: تَلَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ:
تَتَجَافَى جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ الْمَضَاجِعِ [السجدة: 16] فَقَالَ: «هُوَ قِيَامُ الْعَبْدِ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ»
Edition record 373080 · p. 544Link to report ↗
06
Report from Mujāhid 06

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said:
"They used to pray at night."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
«كَانُوا يُصَلُّونَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ»
Edition record 373081 · p. 545Link to report ↗
06

“the lesser punishment”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and ʿAbd Allāh ibn Masʿūd (Q 32:21).

07
Explanation from Mujāhid 07

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
the lesser punishment [al-Sajda 21]: "what struck them of killing and hunger; this is for Quraysh"; and the greater punishment [al-Sajda 21]: "the Day of Resurrection."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
الْعَذَابِ الْأَدْنَى [السجدة: 21] «مَا أَصَابَهُمْ مِنَ الْقَتْلِ وَالْجُوعِ، هَذَا لِقُرَيْشٍ» ، وَ الْعَذَابِ الْأَكْبَرِ [السجدة: 21] «يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ»
Edition record 373082 · p. 545Link to report ↗
08
Explanation from Ibn Masʿūd 08

ʿAbd Allāh ibn Masʿūd

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Israil related to us, from Abu Ishaq al-Hamdani, from Abu al-Ahwas, from Abd God ibn Masud, on His words:
the lesser punishment [al-Sajda 21] he said: "years of famine that struck peoples before you."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الْهَمَذَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
الْعَذَابِ الْأَدْنَى [السجدة: 21] قَالَ: «سِنُونَ أَصَابَتْ قَوْمًا قَبْلَكُمْ»
Edition record 373083 · p. 545Link to report ↗
07

“so do not be in doubt about meeting Him”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 32:23).

09
Explanation from Mujāhid 09

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
so do not be in doubt about meeting Him [al-Sajda 23] meaning: "about Moses meeting [Him] and receiving his Book."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
فَلَا تَكُنْ فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِنْ لِقَائِهِ [السجدة: 23] ، يَعْنِي: «مِنْ أَنْ يَلْقَى مُوسَى وَكِتَابَهُ»
Edition record 373084 · p. 545Link to report ↗
08

“the barren land”

An explanation transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās (Q 32:27).

10
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās 10

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from someone who related it to him, from Ibn Abbas, on His words:
the barren land [al-Sajda 27] meaning: "land that receives only rain that does not suffice it at all, apart from what comes to it from the torrents."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مَنْ، حَدَّثَهُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
الْأَرْضِ الْجُرُزِ [السجدة: 27] ، يَعْنِي: «الْأَرْضَ الَّتِي لَا تُمْطِرُ إِلَّا مَطَرًا لَا يُغْنِي عَنْهَا شَيْئًا إِلَّا مَا يَأْتِيهَا مِنَ السُّيُولِ»
Edition record 373085 · p. 545Link to report ↗
